description.zh-CN: 在岛上加一个页面，列出一个或多个 GitHub 仓库的未关闭 issue，每个仓库一组，点一条就在浏览器里打开。不登录就能看公开仓库；可以选择用 GitHub 账号登录，提高请求次数。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: Adds an island page listing the open issues of one or more GitHub repositories, one group each; click one to open it in the browser. Public repositories work without signing in; signing in with GitHub is optional and raises the request limit. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

description.zh-CN: owner/name，多个用逗号分隔，最多 20 个，例如 TixXin/fly-island, owner/other
description.en: owner/name; separate several with commas (up to 20), e.g. TixXin/fly-island, owner/other

description.zh-CN: 仓库多时会自动拉长，免得用完 GitHub 每小时的请求次数。
description.en: Grows by itself with many repositories so the hourly GitHub limit is not used up.

description.zh-CN: 打开后在插件页面点「登录 GitHub」，用验证码在浏览器里授权。登录后每小时 5000 次请求（不登录是 60 次），只申请读取 issue。令牌存在 Windows 凭据管理器里，需要允许「密钥」权限；关掉这个开关会删除令牌。
description.en: Then choose Sign in on the plugin page and authorize in the browser with a code. Signed in, GitHub allows 5000 calls an hour instead of 60; only issue read access is asked for. The token is kept in the Windows Credential Manager (needs the secrets permission); turning this off deletes it.

description.zh-CN: 留空用插件自带的。想用自己注册的 GitHub App 登录时填它的 Client ID（App 要打开 Device Flow）。
description.en: Leave empty for the plugin's own. Fill in to sign in through a GitHub App you registered (with Device Flow enabled).
